notes:
Account summary
- Europay Analytics (EMEA) evaluating Redwood for an internal compliance/risk analytics assistant + knowledge search.
- Strong bias toward Private/VPC deployment due to data residency and auditability requirements.
- They like the production posture of the Quickstart templates (K8s manifests, OpenTelemetry hooks, error taxonomy) but want explicit guardrails around logging + retention.

What they care about (verbatim-ish)
- "We can’t have prompts or retrieval snippets leaving EU regions." (Data residency requirement is strict; prefers EU-only processing for inference + logs + support access controls.)
- "Audit logs have to go to Splunk, and we need the who/what/when for admin actions." Wants export path + schema clarity.
- "Templates are great, but we need them to be deployable in our VPC with our own collector and zero outbound except to Redwood Private endpoints." 

Current stage: Evaluation
- They are comparing with Azure OpenAI (already approved for some workloads), but they’re worried about cost/latency predictability and want better model routing/fallback + token-cost visibility.
- Interested in Redwood Console parity for Private: dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, and tracing (even if data stays in their environment).

Technical notes / requirements
- Workload: RAG + summarization now, agent tooling later (limited tool allow-list: internal document search + ticket system).
- Latency target: p95 < 2.5s for short answers; ingestion can be batch/async.
- Throughput: early pilot ~5–20 RPS; expected growth if rolled out to ~300 analysts.
- Deployment: Private in EU VPC/VNet; asks about on-prem contingency (not air-gapped today).
- Observability: wants OpenTelemetry to their collector; does not want third-party SaaS exporters by default.
- Audit logging: needs admin audit events (model version changes, routing/fallback policy edits, key creation/rotation) and access logs; retention 90 days preferred; export to Splunk.
- Security: SSO/SAML required; KMS integration (Azure Key Vault likely); strict guidance on PII handling in logs; wants confirmation templates do not log request/response bodies by default.

Template-specific questions
- Asked for: (1) ‘Private-ready’ deployment guide for quickstarts (K8s manifests + sizing), (2) explicit list of required env vars + secrets management patterns, (3) audit log + telemetry retention recommendations.
- Wants confirmation that request_id / tenant_id correlation IDs are generated server-side (avoid user-provided IDs increasing cardinality / injection risk).

Internal action items
- Kira to share Dedicated/Private deployment considerations doc + confirm EU region availability and any limitations.
- Follow up with Naomi Feldman/Marcus Lin for approved wording on template logging defaults and PII redaction guidance (to unblock InfoSec).
- Provide a short ‘audit logging & retention’ one-pager and example SIEM export path (Splunk HEC) for Private deployments.

Risk
- Procurement/security timeline could slip: they require DPA + sub-processor list before any pilot using real data.
- If we can’t clearly commit to EU-only processing for telemetry and support workflows, likely loss to Azure.
